title: Studio 重构后续：左侧菜单分组叫「平台 / 访问」，目录页和类型页的分组标题仍是「系统 / 安全」，统一成同一套名字
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzi4PechTRCTBrfxV8W

③ maintainer direct order · Source: maintainer (Yibo Wang), 2026-11-24 19:03Z: 「立卡并派发」, replying to the explanation 「左侧菜单的分组叫『平台 / 访问』，目录页的标题还是『系统 / 安全』」. Follow-up of the Studio redesign epic #36890 (#36899 nit N4, close-out 7139248742).

## 维护者速读

- Studio 左侧菜单（#36899）把 `system` 和 `security` 两组叫「平台」「访问」，这是修订后 ADR-0084 的组名。
- 但「全部元数据」目录页的分组标题和筛选标签、类型页头部的分组徽标，还在用共享词典，显示「系统」「安全」。同一个 Studio 里两套叫法。
- 这张卡把它们统一成一套。

## What is on main

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioMenuGroupLabel.ts`: the menu's own label, Platform / 平台 and Access / 访问. It is menu-only on purpose, per the seat ruling on #36985.
- `translateMetadataDomain` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts:674`), the shared dictionary, still says System / 系统 and Security / 安全. Its readers:
  - `DirectoryPage.tsx:310` (domain filter chips) and `:344` (group headings);
  - `PageShell.tsx:300` and `:352` (the domain badge on a type/item page). PageShell also renders Setup's kept datasource item page, which is why #36899 left the dictionary unchanged (L1-b (3) S1, 7134737804).

## Proposed

Rename the shared dictionary's `system` → Platform / 平台 and `security` → Access / 访问 in every locale the dictionary carries, so it matches ADR-0084. Then drop the menu-only override in `studioMenuGroupLabel.ts`, or have it read the dictionary. This also changes Setup's datasource badge, which then reads 平台 / Platform. Before choosing between the two routes below, confirm that is acceptable there:
- **(a) Dictionary rename everywhere.** Preferred: one name per group across the product.
- **(b) Studio-scoped.** DirectoryPage and the Studio PageShell use the menu labels; Setup keeps System / Security.

State the choice in the PR body. Pin tests: the directory heading, the chips and the PageShell badge in en and zh-CN.

## Done when

The Studio menu, the directory's group headings and chips, and the type/item page badge show the same group name in en and zh-CN. A pin test holds it.

Dedupe (`gh api search/issues`, is:issue, created today): `directory domain System Security`, `Platform Access headings`. No match.

Part of #36890 (follow-up). Likely `domain:ui`, `area:ux`, size S. The grade is triage's to set.
